Interface Command

All Known Implementing Classes:
ChatStartCommand, ChatStopCommand, ClearCommand, ExitCommand, HelpCommand, MessageEditCommand, MessageFindCommand, MessageListCommand, MessageLockCommand, MessageShowCommand, MessageUnlockCommand, OllamaExecCommand, OllamaLoadCommand, OllamaStopCommand, SelectModelCommand, StatusCommand, SwapCommand
public interface Command
The Command type is one command the chat shell can run. The type supplies the match text, the help text, and the execute logic. CommandProcessor matches the name or an alias and then calls execute(CommandContext, String).

  • Method Details

    • getName

      String getName()
      The getName method returns the canonical command name. The name may contain spaces, as in chat start.
      Returns:
      The canonical name.

    • getAliases

      String[] getAliases()
      The getAliases method returns the alternate names for this command. The result is never null. The empty array means the command has no alternate name.
      Returns:
      The alternate names, and never null.

    • getHelp

    • execute

      void execute(CommandContext ctx, String args) throws Exception
      The execute method runs this command against the current shell. The args text is the remainder of the line after the command name. CommandProcessor passes a remainder that is never null. The processor reports a thrown Exception as a red VT100 error. VT100 is the terminal control set the chat shell paints with.
      Parameters:
      ctx - The session, the writers, and the lifecycle hooks for this connection.
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The command rejected the line, or a step it called failed.
